outcome.limitation: The first live use of exact-claim release recorded the release event with an invalid empty repository value. In the same ECI view, the earlier acquisition event for this claim had recorded repository mncs-environment, so the authoritative repository was available from the held claim but was lost in the release event.
outcome.pressure_hypothesis: An exact claim release should preserve the claim's repository in its transition provenance while remaining scoped to the caller's held claim.
outcome.recurrence: One release event in one campaign session; recurrence is not established.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The ECI result records a coordination transition and invalid event field. It does not establish development failure, reduced intervention, or broader authority-policy failure.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Exact claim release omitted repository context from its event
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment claim release and provenance
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Resolve the repository from the caller's exact held claim before release and preserve it on the release event; retain session ownership and exact-claim checks.

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The pressure is supported by one selected session event window and is not a recurrence estimate.
The projection result is partial and the event window is bounded; unreturned events are not inferred absent.
Agent time, tool calls saved, independent agent discovery, and downstream burden reduction were not measured.
The historical invalid event is immutable and is not rewritten by the subsequent implementation.
